limitations: The formulas are mathematically valid for scalar pointwise multipliers on locally compact Hausdorff \(C_0\)-spaces. The package is rejected as a new finding because its core profile is already present for the more general weighted-composition setting on compact \(C(K)\)-spaces and the remaining locally compact adaptation uses the same standard truncation and disjoint-bump arguments.
record_title: Exact strict s-numbers of pointwise multipliers on C0-spaces
